method: Independent manual walk through complete77ITgroups in existing worksheet, before seeing any v2builder/output. No new corpus, parser infrastructure, source projection or word-value assignment.
rule_reviewed: Every initial q/o/l is a pending unary operator. First non-q/o/l begins one indivisible base consisting of the rest of that whole group. Operator-only wholes wait for the next base across groups and permitted linebreaks. No other normalization.
scope: These are assumed formal-term equalities, not meaning equalities established by measured spacing.
Q/O/L share an unspecified unary type; bases are unassigned values, not universal Class nouns or translated objects.
Consecutive qokedy and qokeey remain separate completed terms. No mandatory right-neighbor argument rule from1137/1146 is inherited.
The69terms form an ordered list, not one asserted sentence, executed process or connected semantic argument.
V1 assigns ol its own O(l_atom); v2 instead attaches its open operators to the next base. Neither interpretation is selected.
751 exposes inherited renderer asymmetry and753 rejects its q-command/o-preparation role contrast. Neither licenses those meanings here.
R771 existential/universal binders and its globally failed frame grammar are not reused.
Coverage is largely supplied by the unrestricted base-tail rule. It is neither independent grammar evidence nor a translated reading.
The term list alone loses original joined/split spelling distinctions. Preserve all raw groups, metadata and separators; no unique raw-spelling inverse from AST alone.
The q/o/l restriction and physical-line continuation are paid hypotheses. Y/P/E/I and inner or terminal q/o/l remain unchanged within the unparsed base tail.
final_checks: Original source object matches full worksheet exactly, including every line metadata object and all group arrays/separators.
All77groupIDs appear exactly once in original order across69terms.
Every AST node source offset and literal fragment reconstructs its original raw group exactly without normalization; terminal base tails are indivisible.

v1file hash unchanged; v2 does not select itself over v1.
